Lead PM — Rewards Card, Toronto on-site.

Maple Pay (Toronto, 120 people, Series C) is a Canadian consumer-credit fintech with a fast-growing rewards card. We're hiring a Lead PM to own rewards, credit-limit increases and in-app card management, leading two PMs. The role is on-site five days a week at our Toronto headquarters and requires relocation to Canada; we sponsor work permits. You'll have shipped consumer-credit product at growth stage and be comfortable running pricing and rewards experiments with real money on the line.
